text:
samir: heads up 1: console pin audit shows ~0.7% of tenants manually pinned to v1 after deprecation banner went live. this is blocking automated rollouts.
lina: ugh. are these user pins or legacy SDK behavior?
samir: mixed. some are `tenant_pin` set via console, others look like client-sent header `Api-Version: v1`.
ops-bot: snapshot: pins_count=42, header_override=13, shadowed=9, flagged=7
harry: quick question: do tenant pins win over header? our intended precedence was header -> console pin -> cookie -> default.
samir: current code says console pin > header (historical reason: support wanted override). that means support actions can unintentionally keep users on v1.
nora: that's surprising. I thought header should always win. can we change precedence without affecting existing support workflows?
lina: we can, but we need a migration plan: flip precedence server-side + add a deprecation-safe mode for staff.
ux: console UX idea: show a tiny warning on the tenant pin control: "This console pin overrides client headers and blocks automated migration." add a `soft-unpin` option that keeps pin visible but allows header to override for 72h.
pm-ella: product: support asked for console pin because they wanted to freeze behavior during customer requests. soft-unpin sounds reasonable as long as we log actions and notify support.
harry: telemetry ask: add a metric `pin_precedence_effect` = count(reqs where pinned=true AND header=present AND effective_version != header). Also include token-weighted variant.
nora: for rollout metrics we should show per-tenant `time_on_v1_post-banner` to prioritize outreach.
samir: ran quick SQL to find offenders:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, pin_source, count(*) reqs, sum(tokens) tokens
FROM requests_24h
WHERE effective_version = 'v1' AND day >= '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY tenant_id, pin_source
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 25;
```
results: several enterprise tenants with support_pin and console_pin as pin_source.
lina: ops change: if we update precedence, we need a short rollback window. propose: 1) deploy precedence change to canary group (5% of tenants) 2) enable audit log + staff notification 3) expose `soft-unpin` in console.
harry: also watch quotas: v2 token accounting differs for streaming chunks. forcing tenants to v2 may spike token usage. add a preflight estimator in console.
ux: preflight modal mock: show estimated change in tokens/hour, projected delta billing, and a toggle `dry-run` (shadow 2h).
pm-ella: product ok but legal wants customers notified if we change their effective routing. so soft-unpin must trigger an email template that support can customize.
ops-bot: canary rollout plan created: precedence-flip-canary id=pc-canary-17, targets=5% tenants, start=1725256123, watch-window=60m.
samir: tracing problem: we've under-sampled pinned v1 traffic for months, so we lack traces. current trace sampling is tied to `effective_version`. we should make a short rule: sample any request with `console_pin` at 10% for 48h.
lina: agree. add distributed trace tag `pin.audit=true` for sampled traces.
harry: rollback criteria: if error-rate increases by >1.5x or token burn increases >30% for pinned tenants, auto-revert precedence change for that tenant cohort.
nora: we also need small API change: a read-only `pin_metadata` endpoint that shows why a pin exists (creator, created_at, note) so SE can triage without guessing.
ux: we should add a tiny badge in tenant activity: "Pinned (console) — hover for details". also include `soft-unpin` history.
pm-ella: action list:
- lina: implement precedence flip canary + rollback hooks (ops)
- samir: wire trace sampling rule and add pin_precedence_effect metric
- ux: mock preflight dry-run modal and `soft-unpin` UI, include email trigger sample
- nora: add read-only pin_metadata API and docs
- harry: add preflight token estimator and quota projection in console

samir: quick note: support teams must sign off on the audit email and the `soft-unpin` UX before canary start. pinging @pm-ella to coordinate.
pm-ella: will sync with support & legal today, expect ok by EOD.
ux: one more: for transparency add `pinned_by_support` column in tenant list and a filter to find pinned tenants.
lina: timeline: aim for canary deploy tomorrow at 09:00 UTC, monitoring board in place.
samir: thanks all. keeping this thread for logs. if anyone finds additional pinned accounts, drop them here and we'll add to canary exclusion/inclusion. :thumbsup:
